body.answer_text: To manually release a payment held in sanctions screening, access your institution's compliance or payment operations management system and locate the specific transaction ID. You will typically need to input your dual-control supervisor credentials, document the compliance officer's written approval in the audit notes, and execute the manual override function. Always ensure that the compliance sign-off is formally archived alongside the transaction record for audit and regulatory tracking purposes.
